title: Stop restoring a build cache in the job that produces the released binaries, because save-if false proves the job cannot poison the cache and not that its output is trustworthy
description: Stop restoring a build cache in the job that produces the released binaries, because save-if false proves the job cannot poison the cache and not that its output is trustworthy
no_spec_change_rationale: The github module owns .github/workflows, so ownership is declared with --spec; the edit removes a caching step and adds prose, so no canonical spec text moves.
acceptance_criteria: The release build job contains no caching step and a comment stating why it must never gain one; the qualify job's cache is unchanged and the reason for leaving it is recorded; release.yml still parses; and CHANGELOG.md states what save-if false does and does not establish, and that two sibling CodeQL alerts were dismissed as already mitigated while this one was not.
